decisions.rationale: The technical stage is conclusion in its separate glossary material; the unified curated ultimate is a different tier and is not falsely claimed as the literal source of this equivalent.
SBYOR BA directly attests undertaking, the cause of the other person dying. The later of the undertaking is an English anaphoric clarification of DEI TSHE, not a second source SBYOR BA.
The full inflected demonstrative directly includes this and points to the just-described undertaking. Keep the bound genitive whole; do not carve off a separate of.

The complete causal instrumental construction is rendered due to. RKYEN condition/cause and whole GYIS jointly establish the relation; the final-s is never detached or assigned a separate lexical exponent.
The complete other-person expression owns other person, the victim rather than the actor whose early death is discussed in the subsequent quotation.

TSHE has curated life but separate glossary/reference time. This occurrence is the time of undertaking, not the later other-time expression. Keep the unambiguous full time word; the resumed undertaking in English has no second source head.
The complete DUS GZHAN directly attests later on. The following GYI TSHE supplies temporal framing but no additional English time word.
First full SHI BA owns dies in the completion condition. The quotation has a separate source SHI BA and English die; neither occurrence is reused.
The abbreviated title directly attests the full Treasure House of Knowledge. Knowledge is an English title expansion of the one-source title, not a separate compound member.
SNGA directly supplies Before in the quoted condition. Its capital is retained exactly from the physical verse layout.
DANG joins the two alternatives and is rendered or in this statement. No replacement of GMR wording with a preferred and is made.
The complete temporal expression directly attests together. It and Before share the following single source SHI BA/die within this quoted line.

Second source SHI BA owns die in the quoted line, distinct from the earlier dies. Current372 has one predicate shared by Before/together, unlike explanations that repeat both verbs; no arbitrary occurrence omission is imported from a different row.
This LA marks the people/situation to which no actual stage applies, rendered for. Those who is the English nominal/relative support, outside the particle.
DNGOS directly attests actual and abbreviates the actual stage here. The tight actual head leaves stage as English nominal expansion rather than asserting a separate source GZHI.
MED directly attests there is no and negates existence of the actual stage in the stated case. The exact initial capital is preserved.
LUS directly has body in its own entry; the distinct PAGS PA skin variant record is kept separate. Body is a complete English possessive base, and the following contracted has is not assigned to LUS.
GZHAN reference other/another supports this body of a new rebirth. The mined a bodhisattva gloss is not used or promoted; another is the complete contextual equivalent.
SKYES directly attests born. Been and the contracted has are English perfect/passive support and remain outside.

Current source PHYIR is the complete reason marker, directly attesting for. Earlier same-verse343 PHYER is already E-201; this correctly spelled quotation is a witness, not another error or license to edit the earlier source.
